arXiv:2601.07241v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Fault-tolerant modular quantum computing requires stabilizer measurements across the modules in a quantum network. For this, entangled states of high quality and rate must be distributed. arXiv:2506.20466v3 Announce Type: replace Abstract: We investigate the generation of genuine tripartite entanglement in a triangular spin-qubit system due to spatially correlated noise. This contrasts sharply with the two-qubit case, where the induced coupling significantly influences the entanglement dynamics.
